annotations.title: Dismiss a failed post from Home

description: Stop showing one failed post target on Home and in today_summary problems, for the signed-in person only. The post is not deleted and its state does not change (target_retry still works, and the post stays in the posts list). It shows on Home again only if a later attempt fails. The person taps Dismiss beside Retry in the app; call this only when they ask. Pass the target_id from today_summary problems; only a failed target can be dismissed.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
